parole.significato: watermelon (a plant — Citrullus lanatus — of the family Cucurbitaceae, with large, juicy fruits)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian арбу́з (arbúz), itself ultimately borrowed from Persian خربز (xarboz).

parole.significato: suitcase, trunk (rectangular, chest-like piece of luggage for carrying clothes)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Russian чемода́н (čemodán), ultimately from Persian جامهدان (jâme-dân, “suitcase”).
